name: I Might Be Wrong: Live Recordings

info.desc: I Might Be Wrong: Live Recordings is a 2001 live album by English rock band Radiohead. It consists of live performances of eight songs recorded on a tour of Europe and North America, including seven songs from their albums Kid A and Amnesiac. The final track, "True Love Waits", would not be released on a studio album until 2016's A Moon Shaped Pool; unlike the studio version, it is performed here on acoustic guitar by Thom Yorke. It was the only release, apart from their studio albums and bonus material from the The King of Limbs sessions, that the band .

podcast.body: A live album released for Christmas 2001. It was a short record, containing 8 songs and lasting 40 minutes, which annoyed some Radiohead fans due to its brevity. However, it was significant as it was the first time Radiohead's live performance abilities were officially and properly documented on CD. "For Christmas 2001, it was decided that a live album was required."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
